title: Gait, Stair-Climb, Actigraphy and Timed Function Endpoints in FDA Approvals and Labeling
summary: FDA precedents for gait, stair-climb, timed function and actigraphy endpoints: which supported approvals or labeling claims, and how reviewers judged them.
body_markdown:
## Gait, stair-climb, actigraphy and timed function endpoints in FDA approvals: what supported labeling and how reviewers judged it


Performance-based functional endpoints have supported FDA approvals and labeled claims in multiple sclerosis, peripheral artery disease, Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), lysosomal storage disorders, hypophosphatasia and pulmonary arterial hypertension. These include timed walks, stair climbs, rise-from-floor tests, the 6-minute walk test (6MWT) and treadmill distance. In the FDA review record, wearable sensor and actigraphy endpoints mostly appear as secondary or exploratory measures. One prominent attempt to use actigraphy as supportive efficacy evidence was rejected because the device was not validated for the target population. The sections below summarize the key precedents and the recurring reviewer concerns.


### Key takeaways


- **A timed walk can carry a labeled claim on its own.** Ampyra (dalfampridine) is indicated "to improve walking in adult patients with multiple sclerosis (MS)," and the indication states this "was demonstrated by an increase in walking speed"[755](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=755) . Pletal (cilostazol) is indicated for symptom reduction in intermittent claudication "as indicated by an increased walking distance"[35](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=35) .
- **Timed function tests anchored some DMD approvals.** Duvyzat (givinostat) used 4-stair climb (4SC) time as its primary endpoint[606](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=606) . Agamree (vamorolone) used time to stand (TTSTAND) velocity[473](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=473) . For Elevidys, CBER's Center Director relied on time to rise, 10-meter walk/run and stair ascent, together with other evidence, for the ambulatory traditional approval after the primary NSAA endpoint failed. Primary reviewers disagreed with that decision[736](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=736)[739](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=739) .
- **Endurance walk tests remain standard in rare and cardiopulmonary disease,** but reviewers repeatedly questioned clinical meaningfulness, MCIDs set after unblinding, effort dependence and outliers[123](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=123)[124](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=124)[125](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=125)[90](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=90) .
- **Sensor-derived endpoints have a thin approval record.** Actigraphy served as the primary efficacy variable in reviews of OTC analgesic/sleep-aid combinations[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=275)[276](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=276) . For Hetlioz LQ, by contrast, FDA concluded that actigraphy could not support effectiveness decisions in Smith–Magenis syndrome[677](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=677) . Wearable measures such as PKG scores (Vyalev), stride velocity 95th centile (Elevidys) and step count (Camzyos) appeared as secondary or exploratory endpoints[780](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=780)[428](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=428)[790](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=790) .


### Regulatory framework reviewers apply


**Performance outcomes (PerfOs).** FDA's final guidance *Patient-Focused Drug Development: Selecting, Developing, or Modifying Fit-for-Purpose Clinical Outcome Assessments* (October 2025) defines a PerfO as a clinical outcome assessment based on standardized, patient-performed tasks. Performance is quantified using predefined procedures[859](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=859) . FDA warns that task performance may say little about functioning outside the test setting. Score changes can also be hard to translate into meaningful daily-life change, so supplementary PRO, ObsRO or ClinRO assessments are often needed[863](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=863) . An earlier PFDD guidance notes that PerfOs depend on patient cooperation and motivation[864](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=864) .


**Digital health technologies (DHTs).** The final guidance *Digital Health Technologies for Remote Data Acquisition in Clinical Investigations* (December 2023) is FDA's main reference[290](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=290) . It asks sponsors to verify that the DHT measures the physical parameter accurately and precisely. FDA also recommends that sponsors validate that it appropriately assesses the clinical characteristic in the proposed population, whether or not the DHT is a device[308](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=308) . Endpoints should be well defined and reliable. FDA recommends stakeholder input on clinical meaningfulness and early discussion with the review division[313](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=313) . Assessments, timing and data aggregation should be defined precisely[314](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=314) . The guidance also asks for prespecified endpoints and plans to reduce missing data, such as monitoring, reminders and run-in periods[315](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=315)[317](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=317) .


**Disease-specific expectations.** The 2018 DMD guidance lists time to climb four stairs, 10-meter walk/run, NSAA and the 6MWT as functional measures for ambulatory patients[870](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=870)[871](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=871) . It flags several 6MWT problems: maturation effects in younger boys, a floor effect once ambulation is lost, sensitivity to how zero values are handled, and non-normal data[871](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=871) . Because functional endpoints can be influenced by effort and coaching, it calls blinding critical. It also recommends standardized encouragement and, where practicable, testers who are unaware of the clinical course[872](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=872) .

### Timed walks as the basis of an indication


#### Ampyra and the T25FW responder endpoint


The pivotal MS-F203 and MS-F204 trials used T25FW responder status rather than mean change. Walks were timed by stopwatch twice per visit and the speeds averaged. A responder walked faster at 3 of 4 on-treatment visits than at the fastest of 5 off-treatment visits[347](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=347)[348](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=348)[349](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=349) . FDA reviewers called the responder definition unconventional and unvalidated. F203's prespecified validation and maintenance tests succeeded, but small mean differences and a nonsignificant global assessment left clinical meaningfulness unresolved[354](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=354)[355](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=355) . Mean speed gains were 0.21 vs 0.05 ft/s (F203) and 0.22 vs 0.11 ft/s (F204)[352](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=352)[353](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=353) . Reviewers also noted that the responder criterion ignored the size of improvement[356](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=356) . They limited generalizability to ambulatory patients who completed 25 feet in 8 to 45 seconds[357](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=357) .


Even so, the final label states the indication as improved walking "demonstrated by an increase in walking speed"[755](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=755) . Section 14 describes the T25FW responder method[361](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=361)[756](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=756) . The label notes an association with MSWS-12 improvement but no established drug–placebo MSWS-12 difference[363](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=363) . A purely performance-based measure carried the claim, with the patient-reported measure kept in a supporting role.


#### Pletal and treadmill walking distance


Cilostazol's program used treadmill-measured absolute claudication distance as the main measure[23](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=23) . It included eight randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials in 2,274 patients[24](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=24) . Reviewers found 100 mg twice daily superior to placebo in six of eight studies, with a weighted pooled effect of about 63 m[25](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=25)[26](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=26) . They noted that baseline distance and treadmill incline limited cross-study comparisons[29](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=29) . LOCF might underestimate delayed benefit, but worst-outcome sensitivity analyses did not change conclusions[32](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=32)[33](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=33) . Agreement with physical quality-of-life results supported meaningfulness[28](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=28) .


### Neuromuscular disease: timed function tests in DMD and ataxia


#### Duvyzat: 4-stair climb as primary endpoint


Study 48 enrolled ambulant boys who had two screening 4SC assessments within one second of each other, averaging 8 seconds or less[199](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=199) . In the primary population (81 givinostat, 39 placebo), 4SC time worsened 1.25 vs 3.03 seconds over 18 months[200](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=200) . The label presents this as "statistically significant less decline," not as improvement from baseline[607](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=607) .


The statistical review was critical. Single imputation understated uncertainty and could bias results toward givinostat[202](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=202) . An observed-data MMRM (p=0.083) and a rank MMRM (p=0.147) were not significant[203](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=203) . One placebo patient imputed as unable to perform the test strongly influenced the variance[205](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=205) . In its regulatory action, FDA still judged the −1.78-second difference clinically meaningful because it reflected less deterioration in a strength-dependent functional outcome[702](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=702) . NSAA, rise from floor and 6MWT favored givinostat but did not reach multiplicity-adjusted significance[703](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=703) . FDA concluded that Study 48 plus confirmatory evidence established effectiveness[709](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=709) .


#### Agamree: time to stand velocity


VBP15-004 used change in TTSTAND velocity (rises/second) at Week 24 as the primary endpoint[473](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=473) . Velocity improved by +0.0483 rises/s on 6 mg/kg vs −0.0120 on placebo (p=0.0018)[476](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=476) . Reviewers described the changes as small, a slight improvement against placebo decline[480](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=480) . They raised a measurement point specific to velocity transforms: near-normal function, reaction-time effects could magnify velocity changes. Sensitivity analyses set a floor of 2.5 seconds on times[483](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=483) . Missing-data, protocol-deviation and influential-observation analyses supported robustness[481](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=481) . Key secondary timed tests also favored treatment: 6MWT +41.6 m (p=0.0033) and 10-m run/walk +0.244 m/s (p=0.0018)[627](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=627)[628](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=628) .


#### Elevidys: secondary timed tests after a failed primary


In Study 301 Part 1, the primary NSAA endpoint was not significant (difference 0.65; p=0.244)[425](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=425)[426](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=426) . Time to rise (−0.64 s) and 10-meter walk/run (−0.42 s) favored treatment[427](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=427) . The stair-ascent difference was −0.36 s (95% CI −0.71, −0.01)[434](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=434) . The Center Director relied on time to rise, 10MWR and stair ascent, together with other evidence, to grant traditional approval for ambulatory patients aged 4 and older[736](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=736)[732](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=732) . Primary reviewers disagreed. The statistical reviewer noted that 10MWR effects pointed in opposite directions in Studies 301 and 102. Without prespecification or type I error control, the analyses were exploratory[738](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=738) . The clinical reviewer recommended a Complete Response[739](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=739) . Clinical reviewers also stressed effort and encouragement dependence and scoring variability[431](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=431) . Elevidys shows that timed tests can support approval through a decision-maker's judgment even when the primary review team does not accept the inference.


#### Exondys 51: when the 6MWT was not accepted


For eteplirsen, FDA reviewers criticized a sponsor analysis that left out two rapidly declining patients who lost ambulation and pooled dose groups without prespecification[451](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=451) . Reviewers said a historical-control difference of that size would be clinically important if seen in a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. However, they judged the 6MWT especially bias-prone and unreliable in the open-label study[452](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=452) . They noted strong effects of effort and motivation near loss of ambulation[448](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=448) . Other problems included unequal testing opportunities for treated patients and controls[455](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=455) and scoring that assigned zero to incomplete tests in historical controls[454](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=454) .


#### Skyclarys: a rating scale with a performance component


Omaveloxolone's mFARS is a neurological-exam-based rating scale whose items include upright stability[391](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=391)[392](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=392) . The primary analysis showed −2.41 points vs placebo (p=0.0138)[393](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=393) . The upright-stability subscore alone was not significant (p=0.1365)[394](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=394) . FDA accepted mFARS but noted uncertainty about the meaningfulness of some items[396](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=396) . Section 14 reports the total mFARS result and lists upright stability as one of four domains[401](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=401)[402](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=402) . The separate subscore result comes from the FDA review.


### Lysosomal and metabolic disease: walk and stair-climb tests


- **Vimizim (MPS IVA).** The primary endpoint was 6MWT change at Week 24. Tests were run twice on separate days and averaged, with walking aids held constant[118](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=118)[119](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=119) . The weekly regimen gained 22.5 m over placebo (p=0.0174); every-other-week dosing gained 0.5 m (p=0.9542)[121](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=121)[122](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=122) . The medical officer called the improvement modest and its clinical meaningfulness unclear[123](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=123) . No MCID was prespecified before unblinding[124](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=124) . Reviewers cited effort dependence, motivation and developmental influences[125](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=125) . An exploratory subgroup with baseline 6MWT of 200 m or less appeared to drive efficacy but could not support a subgroup claim[127](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=127) .
- **Naglazyme (MPS VI).** The 12-minute walk improved by 92 m (p=0.025)[573](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=573) . Baseline imbalance raised regression-to-the-mean concerns, which were partly eased by later placebo-to-active crossover gains[575](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=575)[577](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=577) . Eight subjects had paired tests differing by 200 m or more[578](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=578) . Including one test taken during illness lowered the estimate to 72 m (p=0.052 to 0.059)[579](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=579) . A belt-worn ActiTrac activity monitor used as a secondary endpoint was dropped as unreliable. Subjects did not wear it consistently, and shaking could register as activity[789](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=789) .
- **Lumizyme (late-onset Pompe).** In LOTS, the week-78 6MWT difference was about 28 m (p=0.06)[813](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=813) . Reviewers noted that no guideline defined a clinically meaningful change in Pompe disease and that responder analyses were hard to interpret[816](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=816) . Model assumption violations led to ANCOVA with re-randomization, which moved p from 0.035 to 0.06[819](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=819) .
- **Nexviazyme.** The 6MWT key secondary showed +30.0 m vs alglucosidase alfa. Formal superiority testing was not possible because the primary endpoint failed superiority[508](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=508)[509](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=509) . The label carries the result with a nominal, unadjusted p-value[514](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=514) .
- **Pombiliti.** The primary 6MWD analysis was not significant (5.33 m; p=0.608)[88](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=88) . One comparator patient improved by 355 m, which reviewers considered likely implausible. Including that patient skewed the data and violated MMRM normality, and FDA considered excluding the patient reasonable given questions about effort[90](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=90) . The label reports a 14 m difference (95% CI −1, 28)[92](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=92) . It reports 17 m (nominal p=0.047) in ERT-experienced patients using nonparametric ANCOVA[93](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=93)[94](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=94) .
- **Lamzede (alpha-mannosidosis).** The primary 3MSCT endpoint was not significant (+2.7 steps/min; p=0.41)[57](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=57) . Reviewers placed this against a 7 stairs/min threshold from another disease, since no threshold was established for alpha-mannosidosis[59](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=59) . They excluded the applicant's responder analyses because the thresholds lacked Agency agreement[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=61) . They still judged the three clinical endpoints collectively meaningful[60](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=60) . Section 14 reports the 3MSCT results[64](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=64)[65](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=65) .
- **Strensiq (juvenile-onset HPP).** The 6MWT was a supportive, not primary, measure[235](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=235) . Reviewers judged sustained normal or near-normal walking performance "more than minimally clinically important." Open concerns included measurement error, MCID and differences between European and US reference norms[240](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=240) . They also cited effort dependence and children's understanding as limitations[241](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=241) .


### Cardiopulmonary indications


**Winrevair (PAH).** Week-24 6MWD was the STELLAR primary endpoint, with a Hodges–Lehmann difference of 40.8 m (95% CI 27.5 to 54.1)[533](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=533)[534](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=534) . Missing tests were multiply imputed under a missing-at-random assumption[538](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=538) . Death and worsening imputations and a control-based pattern-mixture analysis (39.9 m) reproduced the result[539](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=539)[541](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=541) . Eligibility required two screening 6MWDs of 150 to 500 m[543](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=543) .


**Attruby (ATTR-CM).** 6MWD was the fourth tier of a hierarchical win-ratio primary endpoint[653](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=653) . Reviewers warned that such composites can be driven by small effects on the least important component[661](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=661) . They concluded that mortality and hospitalization mainly drove the result[662](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=662) . The final label presents 6MWD separately as functional capacity, with a 40 m difference at Month 30[659](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=659)[663](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=663) .


### Sensor-derived and actigraphy endpoints


#### Actigraphy as a primary variable: OTC sleep-aid combinations


The Advil PM review includes an "Analysis of Primary Efficacy Variable: Total Sleep Time derived from Actigraphy"[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=275) . The Aleve PM review lists actigraphic wake after sleep onset and sleep latency as primary efficacy variables, and total sleep time and sleep efficiency as secondary[276](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=276) . These reviews do not include an explicit FDA judgment on actigraphy validity[265](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=265)[268](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=268) . They are the clearest cases found of an actigraphy-derived variable serving as the main efficacy measure in an approved application.


#### Hetlioz LQ: a documented rejection


In the tasimelteon review for sleep disturbances in Smith–Magenis syndrome, actigraphy from a Philips watch was a secondary objective intended as supportive evidence[161](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=161)[164](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=164) . FDA's consultant concluded that the data could not support effectiveness decisions[677](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=677) . The integrated review found that the algorithm classified true wakefulness poorly[678](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=678) . The deficiencies follow the DHT guidance framework closely:


- **Validation in the target population.** Accuracy and reliability had not been established in SMS. Published case-control comparisons did not validate the measurements[679](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=679)[680](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=680) .
- **Algorithm transparency.** The proprietary algorithm was not submitted. Reported sensitivity of 0.96, specificity of 0.38 and accuracy of 0.77 came from adults with sleep disorders[682](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=682)[683](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=683) .
- **Wear compliance.** Five of 25 ITT patients had no actigraphy data, and there was no wear-compliance requirement for analysis[684](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=684)[685](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=685) .
- **Meaningful change.** There was no meaningful-change threshold and no evidence the device could measure such a change precisely[687](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=687) .


The consultant left room for future use of actigraphy as a secondary endpoint if these gaps were addressed[688](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=688) .


#### Wearables as secondary or exploratory endpoints


- **Vyalev (foscarbidopa/foslevodopa).** PKG wearable bradykinesia and dyskinesia scores were secondary endpoints in the gatekeeping hierarchy. Median bradykinesia changed by +1.72 (p=0.0184), and dyskinesia measures were not significant[780](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=780)[782](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=782)[784](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=784) . FDA noted that none of the other secondary endpoints measured clinically meaningful change in patient function[786](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=786) .
- **Elevidys.** SV95C, measured with ankle-worn devices over 3-week windows, was a Study 301 secondary endpoint[589](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=589)[590](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=590) . The review documents cited here report no SV95C result or FDA assessment of it[592](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=592) .
- **Camzyos (mavacamten).** Daily step count and other accelerometer parameters were exploratory endpoints[790](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=790)[791](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=791) . The primary response endpoint used CPET pVO2 combined with NYHA class[879](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=879) .
- **Adasuve (loxapine).** Wrist Actiwatch activity counts were a secondary outcome[274](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=274) .


### Recurring reviewer concerns


1. **Effort, motivation and blinding.** Effort dependence appears in the Vimizim, Strensiq, Pombiliti, Exondys 51 and Elevidys reviews[125](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=125)[241](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=241)[90](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=90)[448](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=448)[431](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=431) . This matches the DMD guidance emphasis on blinding and standardized encouragement[872](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=872) . Reviewers gave open-label and externally controlled walk data little weight[452](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=452) .
2. **Clinical meaningfulness without an agreed threshold.** Reviewers rejected MCIDs and responder thresholds set after unblinding or without agreement[124](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=124)[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=61) . They noted when no disease-specific threshold existed[816](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=816)[59](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=59) . Approvals succeeded when reviewers could link the change to everyday function or slower decline[702](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=702)[239](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=239) .
3. **Missing data and inability to perform.** How "unable to perform" is imputed can determine significance, as with Duvyzat[202](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=202)[205](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=205) . Reviewers look for prespecified missing-data handling and sensitivity analyses, such as the multiple imputation and control-based pattern-mixture analysis in the Winrevair review[539](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=539)[541](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=541) .
4. **Variability, outliers and distribution.** Paired-test discrepancies[578](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=578) , implausible improvers[90](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=90) and non-normal data[482](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=482) repeatedly prompted nonparametric or log-transformed analyses[30](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=30) .
5. **Population and range limits.** Walking-speed windows[357](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=357) , screening 6MWD limits[543](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=543) and subgroups driving efficacy[127](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=127) shaped how far reviewers would extend conclusions.
6. **DHT-specific validation.** For sensor endpoints, reviewers expect population-specific validation, a disclosed algorithm, wear-time rules and a defined meaningful change, as in the Hetlioz LQ review[679](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=679)[682](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=682)[685](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=685)[687](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=687) . They also expect the device to produce data subjects will actually generate, as the Naglazyme ActiTrac experience shows[789](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=789) .


### Implications for endpoint strategy


The precedents point to a practical hierarchy. Standardized, blinded, in-clinic timed tests (T25FW, 4SC, time to rise, TTSTAND, 6MWT) have the longest record of supporting primary efficacy and labeled claims. That record is strongest when the endpoint is prespecified with a defensible approach to missing values and inability to perform, and is backed by a meaningfulness argument agreed before unblinding[702](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=702)[755](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=755) . Wearable and actigraphy measures have mostly reached secondary or exploratory status in the review record. Sponsors who want them to carry efficacy should address the verification, validation, usability and missing-data expectations in FDA's 2023 DHT guidance early with the review division[308](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=308)[313](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=313)[317](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=317) . The Hetlioz LQ review shows in detail which deficiencies lead reviewers to set DHT data aside[677](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=677)[687](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/gait-stair-climb-actigraphy-and-timed-function?showSourceNumber=687) .
